channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Shawn Bradley | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Shawn Bradley from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Olden Polynice on Shawn Bradley
item.description:
He was asked about his thoughts on Victor Wembanyama when he dropped a scorching hot take about the rookie's ceiling.

“He hopes to be better than Shawn Bradley in my opinion. I'm serious,”

Olden Polynice on Shawn Bradley, Jul 24, 2023. Source: Kens5.com.

item.title: Steve Nash on Shawn Bradley
item.description:
Malika Andrews:Steve Nash on his former teammate Shawn Bradley:

“It’s obviously heartbreaking to hear. He is a fun-loving guy... I hope he remains positive and has a lot of support and continues to fight and find some comfort and hopefully to improve and get as much function back as he can.”

Steve Nash on Shawn Bradley, Mar 17, 2021. Source: Twitter @malika_andrews.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Shawn Bradley
item.description:
Ohm Youngmisuk:Ty Lue on Shawn Bradley:

“He might've been the tallest person I had ever seen... to be so thin, he had a lot of toughness behind him. Seeing the height difference between him and myself was unbelievable.”

Tyronn Lue on Shawn Bradley, Mar 17, 2021. Source: Twitter @NotoriousOHM.
